title: Tap-to-Upgrade: Feedback Loops and Inflation Thresholds
subtitle: This article deconstructs the feedback loop and inflation threshold mechanisms in tap-to-upgrade games, detailing how clicks drive upgrade pacing and maintain numerical readability. It equips developers with design strategies for growth loops and numerical balancing in casual games. Character count: 248

breakdown.title: Minimum Loop
bullets: Instant change in feel or efficiency

breakdown.title: Inflation Threshold
bullets: Numbers must be readable: K/M/B segments
Changes must be perceptible: multipliers must cross perception threshold
